code:
-- Primary (postgresql.conf)
wal_level = replica
max_wal_senders = 10
-- pg_hba.conf: authorize a 'replication' connection

-- Standby (postgresql.conf)
primary_conninfo = 'host=primary port=5432 user=replicator ...'
hot_standby = on
-- standby.signal file present in data directory
caption: primary_conninfo points the standby at the primary; standby.signal marks the data directory as a standby.
